BL-1708 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfixes ab1d4cb2bd and d0dd4d36b7 - every aider seat's launch line passes the repo-root model settings and metadata by absolute path and logs its requests with --llm-history-file, and the qwen2.5-coder pack serves the model's native 32k window through a per-model Modelfile with aider's repo map pinned at 1024 tokens - review-only certification (BL-848) of what landed on 2026-09-23
What it solves: ## What
Two operator hotfixes from 2026-09-23, live on main, never through a
gate. This is that gate: a REVIEW ticket - confirm or refute, open
narrow follow-ups for anything found.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed. What needs sign-off is the DISPOSITION only - one review ticket for two same-day hotfixes with one purpose (an aider seat sees the context window and model settings actually served), reviewing the landed diffs rather than r…
BL-1708 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1708" (or "reject BL-1708 <reason>") to act.
